correctness.rationale: The stationary two-variable generator yields exact closed first three radial-energy moments; independent spherical coordinate moment recurrences match for 30 rational dimension/rate pairs. Cubic coefficient signs prove one zero for each dimension and implicit quadratic-in-d comparison proves strict dimension order. Gaussian total cumulance gives K(a,h). The dimension-three numerator has at most two positive roots by Descartes, with strict K_h>0, positive endpoint limits, and a nonempty negative region at h=0 giving one double-root critical noise. All normalization and boundary limits are explicit. Numerical h-star confirms but does not prove root count.

A complete dimension-ordered zero-noise sign transition and an exact thermal reentrant negative-skewness window with a unique coalescence threshold distinguish shell-dominated rare inward excursions from noisy and fast-tumbling central energy fluctuations. This is a global qualitative phase diagram in dimension, tumbling and thermal noise, not a table recomputation or arbitrary parameter slice.
